title: Schooner Clearwater
specs: Small groups for a relaxed experience

blurb: Guests sail on a 52-foot classic schooner with a limit of 22 guests for a relaxed, small-group experience. There is no set route or narration; sailing is guided by an experienced crew and shaped by wind and tides. Guests can bring their own drinks and enjoy the Gulf breeze while possibly seeing dolphins.
extraNote: Guests may bring their own drinks; no drinks sold on board · Schooner Clearwater ticket booth on the west end of Clearwater Municipal Marina
